definition: to get under the covers to sleep
description: A young woman with long dark hair, a grey long-sleeved nightshirt and thick knitted socks climbs from a rope ladder onto a bed built on a wooden platform high above a dark pine forest at dusk, hung from ropes under the branches of a tree. She crawls onto the bed, sits down, pulls a patchwork quilt over herself, lies back on the white pillows and closes her eyes. A small lantern glows warmly on the wooden headboard, and misty forested hills stretch away under a deep blue evening sky.

de.answer: Sie geht in den Bäumen ins Bett.
